websitesimade

A side project born out of a habit I can't shake — finding local businesses stuck with outdated, clunky websites and rebuilding them for free, just to see what they could look like. No clients, no briefs, just real businesses and real rebuilds. Every preview below is the actual live site, running in the frame, not a screenshot.
